description: Compact startup bridge that preserves Tool, selected Project, durable Project Support, and non-authoritative transient workspace separation and routes consequential work to KPR-12-001.
user_intent_examples: Keep the selected Project separate from the KANDA Tool before any source work.
Stop when the source, support, or transient owner is unclear.
when_to_load: Always at startup as a compact invariant; route consequential work to KPR-12-001.
when_not_to_load: It remains startup context but never replaces the full routed canon.
do_not_regress: The bridge must remain compact and non-authoritative.
The bridge must route consequential work to KPR-12-001.
The bridge must keep self-hosting logical identities separate.
The bridge must never authorize mutation.
